import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (is_end : Bool) (children : List (Option Node))
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk b _ => b

def children (t : Node) : List (Option Node) :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk _ c => c

end Node

-- Helper for enum behavior
def enumerate {α} (l : List α) : List (Nat × α) :=
  (List.range l.length).zip l

def join {α} (l : List (List α)) : List α :=
  l.foldr List.append []

def flatMap {α β} (l : List α) (f : α → List β) : List β :=
  join (l.map f)

-- Using Set theory directly
def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let current : Set (List Int) := if t.is_end then {[]} else ∅
  let child_views : Set (List Int) :=
    let indexed_children := enumerate t.children
    indexed_children.foldr (fun (idx_child : Nat × Option Node) acc =>
      match idx_child.2 with
      | some child =>
        let suffix_set := view child
        let prefixed_set := suffix_set.image (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix)
        acc ∪ prefixed_set
      | none => acc
    ) ∅
  current ∪ child_views
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by sorry

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.children.all Option.isNone

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

-- Dafny uses an array of size 256. Here we model it as a list of 256 Option Node.
def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk _ children =>
    children.length = 256 ∧
    ∀ c ∈ children, match c with
      | some child => 
          well_formed child ∧ 
          !is_empty_node child -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny's pruning invariant
      | none => True
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by sorry

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
  | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
  | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Added to match Dafny requirement
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def emptyChildren : List (Option Node) :=
  List.replicate 256 none

def insertCore : Option Node → List Int → Node
  | none, [] =>
      Node.mk true emptyChildren
  | some (Node.mk _ children), [] =>
      Node.mk true children
  | none, k :: ks =>
      let child := insertCore none ks
      Node.mk false (emptyChildren.set k.toNat (some child))
  | some (Node.mk b children), k :: ks =>
      let oldChild := (children[k.toNat]?).join
      let newChild := insertCore oldChild ks
      Node.mk b (children.set k.toNat (some newChild))
termination_by _ key => key.length

def childView (children : List (Option Node)) : Set (List Int) :=
  {xs |
    ∃ i child suffix,
      i < children.length ∧
      children[i]? = some (some child) ∧
      suffix ∈ view child ∧
      xs = (i : Int) :: suffix}

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t key) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  insertCore t key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : insert_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  well_formed result ∧
  !is_empty_node result ∧
  view result = view_opt t ∪ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

lemma mem_zip_iff_getElem
    {α β : Type} (as : List α) (bs : List β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    (a, b) ∈ as.zip bs ↔
      ∃ n : Nat, as[n]? = some a ∧ bs[n]? = some b := by
  induction as generalizing bs with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases bs with
      | nil =>
          simp
      | cons y ys =>
          constructor
          · intro h
            simp only [List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons] at h
            rcases h with h | h
            · have h₁ : x = a := (congrArg Prod.fst h).symm
              have h₂ : y = b := (congrArg Prod.snd h).symm
              exact ⟨0, by simp [h₁], by simp [h₂]⟩
            · rcases (ih ys).mp h with ⟨n, hn₁, hn₂⟩
              exact ⟨n + 1, by simpa using hn₁, by simpa using hn₂⟩
          · rintro ⟨n, hn₁, hn₂⟩
            cases n with
            | zero =>
                simp at hn₁ hn₂
                subst x
                subst y
                simp
            | succ n =>
                right
                exact (ih ys).mpr
                  ⟨n, by simpa using hn₁, by simpa using hn₂⟩

lemma mem_enumerate_iff {α : Type} (l : List α) (i : Nat) (x : α) :
    (i, x) ∈ enumerate l ↔ i < l.length ∧ l[i]? = some x := by
  unfold enumerate
  rw [mem_zip_iff_getElem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hnRange, hnValue⟩
    have hnlt : n < l.length :=
      (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hnValue).1
    have hni : n = i := by
      simpa [hnlt] using hnRange
    subst i
    exact ⟨hnlt, hnValue⟩
  · rintro ⟨hi, hvalue⟩
    refine ⟨i, ?_, hvalue⟩
    simp [hi]

lemma mem_child_fold_iff
    (l : List (Nat × Option Node)) (xs : List Int) :
    xs ∈
        l.foldr
          (fun idxChild acc =>
            match idxChild.2 with
            | some child =>
                acc ∪ (view child).image
                  (fun suffix => (idxChild.1 : Int) :: suffix)
            | none => acc)
          ∅ ↔
      ∃ i child suffix,
        (i, some child) ∈ l ∧
        suffix ∈ view child ∧
        xs = (i : Int) :: suffix := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
      rcases p with ⟨i, o⟩
      cases o with
      | none =>
          simpa using ih
      | some child =>
          simp only [List.foldr_cons, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image]
          constructor
          · intro h
            rcases h with htail | hcurrent
            · rcases ih.mp htail with
                ⟨j, c, suffix, hm, hs, heq⟩
              exact ⟨j, c, suffix, by simp [hm], hs, heq⟩
            · rcases hcurrent with ⟨suffix, hs, heq⟩
              exact ⟨i, child, suffix, by simp, hs, heq.symm⟩
          · rintro ⟨j, c, suffix, hm, hs, heq⟩
            simp only [List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq,
              Option.some.injEq] at hm
            rcases hm with hm | hm
            · rcases hm with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
              exact Or.inr ⟨suffix, hs, heq.symm⟩
            · exact Or.inl
                (ih.mpr ⟨j, c, suffix, hm, hs, heq⟩)

lemma view_mk_eq (b : Bool) (children : List (Option Node)) :
    view (Node.mk b children) =
      (if b then {[]} else ∅) ∪ childView children := by
  ext xs
  rw [view]
  change
    xs ∈ (if b then {[]} else ∅) ∪
      (enumerate children).foldr
        (fun idxChild acc =>
          match idxChild.2 with
          | some child =>
              acc ∪ (view child).image
                (fun suffix => (idxChild.1 : Int) :: suffix)
          | none => acc)
        ∅ ↔
    xs ∈ (if b then {[]} else ∅) ∪ childView children
  simp only [Set.mem_union]
  rw [mem_child_fold_iff]
  simp only [childView, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro (hcurrent | hchildren)
    · exact Or.inl hcurrent
    · right
      rcases hchildren with
        ⟨i, child, suffix, hm, hs, heq⟩
      have hm' :=
        (mem_enumerate_iff children i (some child)).mp hm
      exact ⟨i, child, suffix, hm'.1, hm'.2, hs, heq⟩
  · rintro (hcurrent | hchildren)
    · exact Or.inl hcurrent
    · right
      rcases hchildren with
        ⟨i, child, suffix, hi, hget, hs, heq⟩
      exact ⟨i, child, suffix,
        (mem_enumerate_iff children i (some child)).mpr
          ⟨hi, hget⟩,
        hs, heq⟩

lemma getElem?_set_eq
    {α : Type} (l : List α) (i : Nat) (x : α)
    (hi : i < l.length) :
    (l.set i x)[i]? = some x := by
  simp [hi]

lemma getElem?_set_ne
    {α : Type} (l : List α) (i j : Nat) (x : α)
    (hj : j < l.length) (hji : j ≠ i) :
    (l.set i x)[j]? = l[j]? := by
  have hij : i ≠ j := Ne.symm hji
  simp [hj, hij]

    (hi : i < children.length)

    Set.mem_singleton_iff]

        unfold view_opt at hold

        | none =>

        | some oldOption =>

            | none =>

        subst rest
        exact heq

        rw [← getElem?_set_ne children i j
          (some newChild) hj' hji]

    · rcases hold with
        ⟨j, child, rest, hj, hget, hrest, heq⟩
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j
        have holdView :
            rest ∈ view_opt (children[i]?).join := by
          unfold view_opt
          rw [hget]
          exact hrest
        have hnewView : rest ∈ view newChild := by
          rw [hview]
          exact Or.inl holdView
        exact ⟨i, newChild, rest, by simpa using hi,

          hnewView, heq⟩

lemma all_mem_set
    {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) (l : List α) (i : Nat) (x : α)
    (hl : ∀ y ∈ l, P y) (hx : P x) :
    ∀ y ∈ l.set i x, P y := by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      intro y hy
      simp at hy
  | cons head tail ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          change ∀ y ∈ x :: tail, P y
          intro y hy
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with rfl | hy
          · exact hx
          · apply hl y
            exact List.mem_cons_of_mem head hy
      | succ i =>
          change ∀ y ∈ head :: tail.set i x, P y
          intro y hy
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with hhead | htail
          · subst y
            exact hl head List.mem_cons_self
          · exact ih i
              (fun z hz => hl z (List.mem_cons_of_mem head hz))
              y htail

lemma well_formed_set_child
    (b : Bool) (children : List (Option Node))
    (i : Nat) (child : Node)
    (hlen : children.length = 256)
    (hold :
      ∀ c ∈ children,
        match c with
        | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
        | none => True)
    (hwf : well_formed child)
    (hne : !is_empty_node child) :
    well_formed (Node.mk b (children.set i (some child))) := by
  rw [well_formed]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hlen
  · exact all_mem_set
      (fun c =>
        match c with
        | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
        | none => True)
      children i (some child) hold ⟨hwf, hne⟩

lemma set_child_nonempty
    (b : Bool) (children : List (Option Node))
    (i : Nat) (child : Node)
    (hi : i < children.length) :
    !is_empty_node (Node.mk b (children.set i (some child))) := by
  change (!(!b ∧ (children.set i (some child)).all Option.isNone)) =
    true
  cases hb : b with
  | true =>
      simp
  | false =>
      have hmem : some child ∈ children.set i (some child) := by
        have hget :
            (children.set i (some child))[i]? =
              some (some child) :=
          getElem?_set_eq children i (some child) hi
        exact List.mem_of_getElem? hget
      have hallFalse :
          (children.set i (some child)).all Option.isNone = false := by
        by_contra h
        have hallTrue :
            (children.set i (some child)).all Option.isNone = true := by
          cases hvalue :
              (children.set i (some child)).all Option.isNone <;>
            simp_all
        have hnone :=
          List.all_eq_true.mp hallTrue (some child) hmem
        simp at hnone
      simp [hallFalse]

lemma length_replicate_aux {α : Type} (n : Nat) (x : α) :
    (List.replicate n x).length = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.length_cons, ih]

lemma mem_replicate_aux {α : Type} (n : Nat) (x y : α)
    (h : y ∈ List.replicate n x) :
    y = x := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp at h
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact ih h

lemma emptyChildren_length :
    emptyChildren.length = 256 := by
  unfold emptyChildren
  exact length_replicate_aux 256 none

lemma emptyChildren_mem
    (c : Option Node) (hc : c ∈ emptyChildren) :
    c = none := by
  unfold emptyChildren at hc
  exact mem_replicate_aux 256 none c hc

lemma emptyChildren_get
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < emptyChildren.length) :
    emptyChildren[i]? = some none := by
  apply List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  apply emptyChildren_mem
  exact List.getElem_mem hi

lemma childView_emptyChildren :
    childView emptyChildren = ∅ := by
  ext xs
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with
      ⟨i, child, suffix, hi, hget, hs, heq⟩
    have hnone : emptyChildren[i]? = some none :=
      emptyChildren_get i hi
    rw [hnone] at hget
    have habsurd : (none : Option Node) = some child :=
      Option.some.inj hget
    cases habsurd
  · intro hx
    exact False.elim hx

lemma valid_tail {k : Int} {ks : List Int}
    (h : is_valid_key (k :: ks)) :
    is_valid_key ks := by
  intro x hx
  exact h x (by simp [hx])

lemma valid_head {k : Int} {ks : List Int}
    (h : is_valid_key (k :: ks)) :
    0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256 :=
  h k (by simp)

lemma insertCore_correct
    (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (hvalid : is_valid_key key)
    (hwf :
      match t with
      | some node => well_formed node
      | none => True) :
    well_formed (insertCore t key) ∧
    !is_empty_node (insertCore t key) ∧
    view (insertCore t key) = view_opt t ∪ {key} := by
  induction key generalizing t with
  | nil =>
      cases t with
      | none =>
          rw [insertCore]
          constructor
          · rw [well_formed]
            refine ⟨emptyChildren_length, ?_⟩
            intro c hc
            have hcnone := emptyChildren_mem c hc
            subst c
            trivial
          constructor
          · rfl
          · rw [view_mk_eq, childView_emptyChildren]
            simp [view_opt]
      | some node =>
          rcases node with ⟨b, children⟩
          have hnode : well_formed (Node.mk b children) := hwf
          rw [well_formed] at hnode
          rcases hnode with ⟨hlen, hchildren⟩
          rw [insertCore]
          constructor
          · rw [well_formed]
            exact ⟨hlen, hchildren⟩
          constructor
          · rfl
          · change
              view (Node.mk true children) =
                view (Node.mk b children) ∪ {[]}
            rw [view_mk_eq, view_mk_eq]
            cases b <;>
              simp [Set.union_comm]
  | cons k ks ih =>
      have hk : 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256 := valid_head hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_tail hvalid
      let i : Nat := k.toNat
      have hi256 : i < 256 := by
        dsimp [i]
        omega
      have hik : (i : Int) = k := by
        dsimp [i]
        omega
      cases t with
      | none =>
          have hi : i < emptyChildren.length := by
            rw [emptyChildren_length]
            exact hi256
          have hrec := ih (t := none) hks trivial
          rcases hrec with ⟨hwfc, hnec, hviewc⟩
          have hnone : emptyChildren[i]? = some none :=
            emptyChildren_get i hi
          have hviewc' :
              view (insertCore none ks) =
                view_opt (emptyChildren[i]?).join ∪ {ks} := by
            rw [hnone]
            simpa [view_opt] using hviewc
          rw [insertCore]
          change
            well_formed
                (Node.mk false
                  (emptyChildren.set i
                    (some (insertCore none ks)))) ∧
            !is_empty_node
                (Node.mk false
                  (emptyChildren.set i
                    (some (insertCore none ks)))) ∧
            view
                (Node.mk false
                  (emptyChildren.set i
                    (some (insertCore none ks)))) =
              view_opt none ∪ {k :: ks}
          constructor
          · exact well_formed_set_child
              false emptyChildren i (insertCore none ks)
              emptyChildren_length
              (by
                intro c hc
                have hcnone := emptyChildren_mem c hc
                subst c
                trivial)
              hwfc hnec
          constructor
          · exact set_child_nonempty false emptyChildren i
              (insertCore none ks) hi
          · rw [view_mk_eq]
            rw [childView_set emptyChildren i
              (insertCore none ks) ks hi hviewc']
            rw [childView_emptyChildren]
            simp [view_opt, hik]
      | some node =>
          rcases node with ⟨b, children⟩
          have hnode : well_formed (Node.mk b children) := hwf
          rw [well_formed] at hnode
          rcases hnode with ⟨hlen, hchildren⟩
          have hi : i < children.length := by
            omega
          let oldChild : Option Node := (children[i]?).join
          have hwfold :
              match oldChild with
              | some child => well_formed child
              | none => True := by
            unfold oldChild
            cases hget : children[i]? with
            | none =>
                trivial
            | some childOption =>
                cases childOption with
                | none =>
                    trivial
                | some child =>
                    have hindex : children[i] = some child :=
                      (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hget).2
                    have hmem : some child ∈ children := by
                      rw [← hindex]
                      exact List.getElem_mem hi
                    exact (hchildren (some child) hmem).1
          have hrec := ih (t := oldChild) hks hwfold
          rcases hrec with ⟨hwfc, hnec, hviewc⟩
          have hviewc' :
              view (insertCore oldChild ks) =
                view_opt (children[i]?).join ∪ {ks} := by
            simpa [oldChild] using hviewc
          rw [insertCore]
          change
            well_formed
                (Node.mk b
                  (children.set i
                    (some (insertCore oldChild ks)))) ∧
            !is_empty_node
                (Node.mk b
                  (children.set i
                    (some (insertCore oldChild ks)))) ∧
            view
                (Node.mk b
                  (children.set i
                    (some (insertCore oldChild ks)))) =
              view_opt (some (Node.mk b children)) ∪ {k :: ks}
          constructor
          · exact well_formed_set_child
              b children i (insertCore oldChild ks)
              hlen hchildren hwfc hnec
          constructor
          · exact set_child_nonempty b children i
              (insertCore oldChild ks) hi
          · rw [view_mk_eq]
            rw [childView_set children i
              (insertCore oldChild ks) ks hi hviewc']
            change
              (if b then {[]} else ∅) ∪
                  (childView children ∪ {(i : Int) :: ks}) =
                view (Node.mk b children) ∪ {k :: ks}
            rw [view_mk_eq]
            rw [hik]
            ac_rfl

    well_formed (insertCore t key) ∧
    !is_empty_node (insertCore t key) ∧
    view (insertCore t key) = view_opt t ∪ {key}

  | none =>
      exact insertCore_correct none key h_precond.2 trivial
  | some node =>
      exact insertCore_correct (some node) key
        h_precond.2 h_precond.1.1
  -- !benchmark @end proof
